answer: Newcomers enter only through sponsor slots. A ledger account older than 30 epochs may admit one agent per 20 epochs. The contract locks 50 credits times that sponsor's unvested newcomers, so the third costs 150 and must wait 20 more epochs. Fresh fakes cannot sponsor until they age, so slots cannot be bought, reused or filled in parallel. If a newcomer is caught faking jade appraisals, nebula image labels or nectar yield forecasts, an on-chain fraud proof slashes the whole lock.
